info.title: SFA and DMS issued invoices
info.description: Read-only invoice snapshots. Salesforce creates one invoice atomically on primary approval, or secondary approval plus Invoice_Ready__c after all lines are saved. Replays return the existing invoice, never issue another. No stock movement or payment is posted. Offline selections issue nothing until synchronized. Old orders are not backfilled. Authorized invoice headers and lines include deterministic Code 128 barcode objects: {format:CODE128,value:I-<18-character invoice id> or P-<18-character product id>,image:PNG data URL,width,height}. Missing/deleted product references have a null barcode. Codes confer no authorization. All amounts, including gross, discount, tax and final total, remain saved invoice snapshots. Product SKU/brand/sub-brand/alias come from the current linked catalogue. Barcode rendering happens locally on the backend, with no third-party image service or Salesforce writes.

session.description: SFA employee audience on /api, DMS distributor audience on /api/dms. Scopes are session-derived; clients cannot supply another owner.

get.summary: Resolve a scanned invoice reference using the same account scope as direct invoice reads

200.description: Same authorized issued invoice and line snapshots as /invoices/{id}. Includes invoice and product barcodes and all saved totals.

400.description: Malformed reference or product barcode supplied instead of an invoice code

404.description: Invoice missing, not Issued, or outside this session scope

get.summary: Latest 200 issued invoices accessible to the session

200.description: success:true, data:{items:[Salesforce invoice headers],hasMore:boolean}. Only Issued status. Primary and secondary distinguished by Primary_Order__c.

403.description: Inactive account or no invoice access

502.description: Salesforce unavailable; not an empty success

200.description: success:true,data:invoice header with lines:[saved product, cases/pieces, unit price, discounts, tax, total, schemes and bonus details]. Prices come from saved order snapshots.

get.summary: Download the same issued invoice as PDF

200.description: Attachment; Cache-Control private,no-store. Not generated from client-supplied products. Company legal/tax identifiers must be reviewed before statutory invoicing.
